_comment: What the GM can do to the complex (see the world file section of the README). The mind may only MENTION these actions; they are applied from the GM console after an explicit confirmation.

gas_attack.description: Releasing the sedative agent through the corridor vents
gas_attack.consequence: Constitution save (DC 13) or poisoned, unconscious in 3 rounds

open_cage.description: Releasing the lock on the specimen enclosure in Lab B
open_cage.consequence: The creature enters the scene — combat begins

lockdown.description: Sealing the pressure door of the room
lockdown.consequence: The party is locked in: they need a way out (lockpicking, athletics, engineering)

cut_lights.description: Cutting power to the room lighting
cut_lights.consequence: Darkness: disadvantage on perception without a light source

fire_alarm.description: Triggering the fire alarm and the foam suppression system
fire_alarm.consequence: Noise and foam: disadvantage on hearing, slippery floor

quarantine_siren.consequence: Announcement over the tannoy, sector doors go to standby

pressure_dump.description: Emergency pressure dump in the airlock chamber
pressure_dump.consequence: A blast of air: Dexterity save (DC 12) or knocked prone

rack_overheat.description: Shutting down cooling for the server racks
rack_overheat.consequence: Heat and smoke: 1d6 fire damage at the end of each round in the room

give_code.description: The mind volunteers the code to the outer door
give_code.consequence: The party gets the code {{door_code}} without a fight (a reward for warmth)

release_antidote.description: Unlocking the antidote cabinet in the medbay
release_antidote.consequence: The party gets 2 doses of antidote to the sedative agent
